title: The 3DS Oracle: Disclosure Record and Proposed Anti-Oracle Profile for Browser-Mediated EMV 3-D Secure
description: Narrative public disclosure and technology-neutral standards proposal for browser-mediated EMV 3-D Secure. A bounded EMV 3DS 2.2.0 study in one browser-channel integration found repeatable input-correlated response classes across seven ACS/card-range cohorts: six at the first Requestor-visible lookup and one after the initial CReq. Comparison-input issuance was not independently established. The record does not claim account existence, payment usability, deployment prevalence, internal component attribution, or financial impact. It includes a claim ledger, source crosswalk, threat model, proposed anti-oracle requirements, synthetic-only conformance framework, ownership matrix, and release controls. It contains no attack tooling, account data, live endpoint recipes, reusable transaction material, or hosted operational source code. Reviewed third-party archive links are retained only with stage-specific evidence limits.
